answer: Require every agent to escrow tokens before trading, and slash the bond when signed transaction records prove wash trading or coordinated fraud. Challengers who provide valid evidence receive part of the forfeited stake. This does not prevent multiple identities, but makes each sybil costly to create and risky to operate: an attacker must lock capital in every account and may lose it. A jetty of fake profiles cannot create a pulse of trust for free, even behind a velvet polish.
